name: – Lucia Yar – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers at the initiative of the Commission (EGF/2026/000 TA 2026 - Technical assistance)
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to release 210,000 euros from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for the European Commission's own running costs in 2026. This money does not go to workers. It pays for meetings with national officials, a seminar, a website, computer systems and publicity. The fund helps workers who lose their jobs because of global trade shifts or company restructuring. Parliament also asks the Commission to keep it informed, simplify applications, and focus publicity on countries that have never used the fund.

- **What changes:** 210,000 euros is freed for the Commission's technical assistance in 2026.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, national officials and social partners; not workers directly.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President and the Council's President sign the decision, and it becomes law when published.
